title: Binary normalization by chunks
statement: Let $w$ be a finite bit string of length at most $N$. For each $i=0,ldots,N-1$, take the first bit of the suffix of $w$ beginning at position $i$, if that suffix contains a $1$, and otherwise take the empty string. Concatenating these strings gives the binary expansion of the natural number represented by $w$, with the least significant bit first.
